name: Inquisitive
summary: A detective who roots out lies and spots weaknesses.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.short: Treat Insight rolls below 8 as 8 to spot lies.
features.summary: When you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.summary: You can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.short: Bonus action: read a foe to Sneak Attack without advantage.
features.summary: As a bonus action, make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by a creature's Deception. On a success, you can use Sneak Attack against it even without advantage (but not with disadvantage) for 1 minute.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.short: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move at half speed.
features.summary: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks if you move no more than half your speed on that turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.short: Action: sense illusions and shapechangers within 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, you sense the presence of illusions, shapechangers not in their original form, and other magic designed to deceive within 30 ft. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.short: Sneak Attack deals +3d6 against your Insightful Fighting target.
features.summary: While Insightful Fighting applies to a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against it increases by 3d6.
